Absolute vs Relative Paths in Linux: Made Easy
https://www.linuxteck.com/absolute-vs-relative-path/

Absolute or relative path? The difference is simple once you understand where Linux starts looking.

Learn how /, ., .., and ~ work, plus practical examples with pwd, cd, and realpath.

Also see why absolute paths matter in scripts and cron jobs.
